mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% in a month, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 in the opposite direction.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls and declining unemployment rate signal robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing recovery regime with rising new housing starts, the S&P 500 produces positive returns over the next 60 trading days as housing sector expansion supports broader economic growth and corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC for housing recovery regime falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% indicates weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 8.0%, or Rank IC for unemployment signal falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.0%) and strong economic growth (GDPC1 above 2.0% annualized) signal a favorable 'Goldilocks' environment that supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime characterized by declining industrial production, the S&P 500 produces negative returns over the next 60 trading days as reduced output signals weakening corporate earnings and economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is declining (monthly change < 0), or Rank IC for manufacturing slowdown regime falls below 0.03.
